parameters.query:
SELECT id, google_calendar_id, name
FROM public.calendar_sources
WHERE is_active = true
  AND (
    $1 = ''
    OR id::text IN (SELECT unnest(string_to_array($1, ',')))
  );

SELECT id, calendar_source_id, assignee_id, patient_id,
       start_datetime, end_datetime, status
FROM public.appointments
WHERE start_datetime < $1::timestamp
  AND end_datetime   > $2::timestamp
  AND status NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled')
  AND ($3::int IS NULL OR id <> $3::int)
ORDER BY start_datetime;

SELECT id, name, email
FROM public.users
WHERE $1::text IS NOT NULL
  AND $1::text <> ''
  AND id = $1::uuid;

WITH params AS (
  -- Forzamos el casteo explícito a TIMESTAMPTZ para anular cualquier magia del driver de n8n
  SELECT $1::timestamptz AS check_time,
         'America/Montevideo'::text AS clinic_tz
),
available_users AS (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM params p, LATERAL public.get_available_users(p.check_time, p.clinic_tz)
)
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email
FROM public.users u
WHERE u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM available_users);

SELECT id, calendar_source_id, assignee_id, patient_id,
       start_datetime, end_datetime, status
FROM public.appointments
WHERE start_datetime < $1::timestamp
  AND end_datetime   > $2::timestamp
  AND status NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled')
  AND ($3::int IS NULL OR id <> $3::int)
ORDER BY start_datetime;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT 'America/Montevideo' AS clinic_timezone,
         (COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), '60')::int * INTERVAL '1 minute') AS slot_interval
),
hourly_slots AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    $1::timestamptz,
    $2::timestamptz,
    (SELECT slot_interval FROM params)
  ) AS local_hour
)
SELECT
  h.local_hour AS local_hour_tz,
  COUNT(available.user_id) AS cantidad_disponibles,
  jsonb_agg(available)     AS ids_disponibles
FROM hourly_slots h, params p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.get_available_users(h.local_hour, p.clinic_timezone) AS available
GROUP BY h.local_hour
ORDER BY h.local_hour;
